milestones.title: Foundation, protocol design and failing tests
milestones.description: Write failing XCTest cases for the frame codec, the peer registry state machine and transport selection; define the LAN protocol, the LANPeer model, the feature flag and configuration keys; decide where the new code lives and how it is registered with the Xcode project.

todos.text: Write failing unit tests for the frame codec: round trip, malformed frame rejection, partial write, oversized frame
Write failing unit tests for the peer registry state machine: discovered to handshaking to authenticated to disconnected, plus timeout expiry
Write failing unit tests for transport selection: Wi-Fi over BLE over Nostr priority and fallback when the LAN permission is denied
Define the LAN transport protocol, the LANPeer model and the LAN feature flag and configuration keys
Decide and document where the new code lives (pure-Swift core plus Apple-framework shell) and how it is registered with the Xcode project

milestones.algorithmic_complexity: O(1) per frame decode, O(n) peer table scan with n up to 32 concurrent peers

milestones.title: Local-network discovery and encrypted session establishment
milestones.description: Implement the frame codec and the read/write state machine over a byte stream with idle and handshake timeouts; implement NWBrowser discovery and NWListener accept; implement the Noise handshake over the LAN link; implement the peer registry and the peer snapshot publication.

todos.text: Implement the frame codec and the read/write state machine over a byte stream with idle and handshake timeouts
Implement NWBrowser discovery and NWListener accept, with a _bitchat._tcp service type and a configurable service name suffix
Implement the Noise handshake over the LAN link using the existing session and key material, including failure and timeout paths
Implement the peer registry and the peer snapshot publication from the LAN transport
Write and pass the unit tests with a mock link, and cover reconnection and duplicate-peer handling

milestones.algorithmic_complexity: O(1) per frame decode, O(n) peer table scan with n up to 32 concurrent peers

milestones.title: Integration with the unified peer list and message routing
milestones.description: Conform the LAN transport to the existing transport contract and the peer-events delegate; route public and private messages over the LAN link; integrate LAN peers into UnifiedPeerService; implement transport selection priority and fallback.

todos.text: Conform the LAN transport to the existing transport contract and the peer-events delegate, mapping every event to the existing typed transport events
Route public and private messages over the LAN link and deliver inbound messages into the existing MessageRouter path
Integrate LAN peers into UnifiedPeerService so they merge with BLE and Nostr peers by identity and appear in the existing peer list
Implement transport selection priority and fallback when the LAN link is down, denied or degraded
Run the existing test suite in CI and fix any regression without changing BLE behaviour

milestones.algorithmic_complexity: O(n) per send across the peer table, n up to 32 peers

milestones.title: Feature flag, settings UI and Local Network permissions
milestones.description: Add the settings toggle, the permission request on enable and the clear denied/unavailable states; add NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription and NSBonjourServices to the iOS and macOS Info.plist files and the macOS sandbox network entitlements; show LAN peers with their transport badge and the LAN state in the connectivity indicator.

todos.text: Add the settings toggle, the permission request on enable, and the clear denied/unavailable states
Add NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription and NSBonjourServices to the iOS and macOS Info.plist files and the macOS sandbox network entitlements
Show LAN peers in the peer list with their transport badge, and show the LAN state in the existing connectivity indicator
Implement the fallback UX when the permission is denied, when no LAN is reachable, and when only BLE peers are present
Add the pure-Swift unit tests for the flag, the permission state machine and the transport-selection fallbacks

milestones.title: Documentation, CI validation and pull request
milestones.description: Write docs/WIFI_TRANSPORT.md, push the feature branch and open a pull request, run the macOS CI and triage failures, update the repository conventions and produce the final honest report.

todos.text: Write docs/WIFI_TRANSPORT.md covering the wire format, the handshake, the permissions, the security limits and the unsupported features
Push the feature branch and open a pull request against the fork default branch with a clear description of what still needs a Mac
Run the macOS CI, triage the compile and test failures, and iterate until the suite is green
Update the repository AGENTS.md, CHECKS.md and MANUAL.md conventions if the transport adds new checks or commands
Produce the final honest report: what was verified in CI, what needs Xcode and a physical device, and what is explicitly out of scope
